targets.rawSql: SELECT symbol AS "Инструмент", strategy AS "Стратегия", timeframe AS "TF", policy_name AS "Exit policy", radar_enabled AS "Radar", runtime_enabled AS "Runtime", raw_profit_factor AS "Raw PF", exit_alpha_pf AS "Exit PF", raw_expectancy AS "Raw Exp", exit_alpha_expectancy AS "Exit Exp", evaluated_trades AS "Оценено", no_bars_trades AS "Без баров", bias_alignment AS "MTF", volatility_state AS "Vol", reason AS "Причина" FROM v_exit_alpha_radar_dashboard ORDER BY exit_alpha_pf DESC, exit_alpha_expectancy DESC;
